ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: In a uniform magnetic field whose direction is perpendicular to the paper inward, there is a U-shaped metal guide rail. The plane of the guide rail is perpendicular to the magnetic field. Metal rod PQ is placed on the guide rail and forms a closed loop PQRS with the guide rail. A circular metal wire frame T is located inside the region enclosed by the loop, and the wire frame is coplanar with the guide rail. Now let metal rod PQ suddenly move to the right. At the instant when the motion begins, regarding the direction of induced current, which of the following statements is correct (　　)
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text: In PQRS it is along the counterclockwise direction, and in T it is along the clockwise direction

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure, multiple crosses are used to indicate that the direction of the uniform magnetic field is perpendicular to the paper surface and inward; the left side of the U-shaped metal guide rail is a fixed side, and the vertical metal rod on the right side is labeled PQ. PQ and the guide rail form the closed loop PQRS; the arrow shows PQ moving to the right; the circular wire frame T is located within the region enclosed by PQRS. Reasoning: This question asks to determine the direction of the induced current in the loop PQRS, not the circular ring T. When PQ moves to the right, the area of the closed loop PQRS increases. Since the external magnetic field direction is inward, the inward magnetic flux passing through PQRS increases. According to Lenz's law, the magnetic field produced by the induced current must hinder the increase of the inward magnetic flux, so the induced magnetic field should be perpendicular to the paper surface and outward. By the right-hand screw rule, the direction of the current that can produce an outward magnetic field inside the loop is counterclockwise.

method.method_draft: 从图中确认：磁场用叉号表示，方向垂直纸面向里；U形导轨左端固定，金属杆PQ是右侧可动边，箭头表示PQ向右运动，因此闭合回路PQRS的面积在增大。由题干确认要求判断的是回路PQRS中的感应电流方向，而不是圆环T。由于外磁场向里且回路面积增大，穿过PQRS的向里磁通量增大。根据楞次定律，感应电流产生的磁场应阻碍这种增加，即感应磁场应垂直纸面向外。再用右手螺旋定则判断：能产生向外磁场的环路电流方向为逆时针方向。
